annotations.title: Bulk URL safety check: up to 10 links in one call

description: Bulk URL safety check: send up to 10 links in one call and one payment. Each link gets a compact /pack/url-safety answer: phishing blocklists on every host it passes through, where it really leads, domain age and trust, HTTPS, security headers, named risk signals and an overall low/medium/high risk. Use to vet a list of links from emails, chats or scraped pages in one paid call; a link that cannot be checked gets its own row. Example: urls=https://github.com,https://example.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
